opening.text: I'm quite short of breath and it's hard to breathe. The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply, and my symptoms get worse when I exert myself but ease off when I rest. I've had a spontaneous pneumothorax before, and someone in my family has had one too. I smoke cigarettes.
